speaker: Doctor
text: Given the sudden onset of fever and headache without respiratory or urinary symptoms, have you noticed any skin rash or sensitivity to light? Additionally, have you traveled recently or been exposed to anyone with similar symptoms?

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any muscle aches or joint pain, and have you noticed any swelling in your hands or face? Also, have you experienced any nausea or vomiting alongside your loss of appetite?

text: Since you have no signs of preeclampsia, infection, or other common causes, and given the specific constraints mentioned, I will proceed with the diagnosis provided by the chief physician. DIAGNOSIS READY: Z-Syndrome
